CONVENTIONAL TRAILER
While typically used to describe recreational trailers, such as campers
or boat trailers, conventional trailers generally utilize a ball-type hitch.

Fifth-wheel trailers can be slightly larger than conventional trailers
and offer a wide range of configurations. These trailers are designed
specifically for pickups equipped with a fifth-wheel hitch.

GOOSENECK TRAILER
Gooseneck trailers place the hitch weight of the trailer over the rear
